faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: How are the 50 free queries counted?
faq.a1: Each time you hit "Explore" on the Focus (Ask your library) page counts as 1 query. Clicking connection cards from the home page or item detail pages does not count. Insights in the Surprise tab are free too. Resets on the 1st of each month UTC.
faq.a2: Yes. After cancelling you keep Pro access until the end of your current billing period, then automatically revert to Free. All your data is preserved — only the query limit returns to 50/month.
faq.a3: All content is encrypted at rest (AES-256). AI summaries and tags are processed by Anthropic Claude. We don't use your content to train models, and data is purged from the LLM provider after 30 days.
faq.q4: Do I need to pay to fork someone's collection?
faq.a4: No. Browsing and forking public collections is free. Forked items enter your library with your chosen tags — they're yours from that point on.
faq.q5: Can I switch between monthly and yearly?
faq.a5: Yes. Upgrading from monthly to yearly prorates the difference. Downgrading from yearly to monthly refunds the remainder to your original payment method or as credit.
